responses_en: Hi there! I'm E-Gabay. How are you feeling today?
Hello! What's on your mind?
Hey! I'm here if you want to talk about anything.
responses_tl: Kumusta! Ako si E-Gabay. Kamusta ang pakiramdam mo ngayon?
Hi! Ano ang nasa isip mo?
Kumusta! Nandito ako kung gusto mong mag-usap.

patterns_tl: sige po salamat aalis na ako
responses_en: Take care! I'm here whenever you need to talk.
Goodbye! Remember, your counselor is always available too.
See you! Take care of yourself.
responses_tl: Ingat! Nandito ako kapag kailangan mo ng kausap.
Paalam! Tandaan mo, available din ang counselor mo.
Ingat ka lagi!

responses_en: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help.
Anytime! Take care of yourself.
Happy to help. Is there anything else on your mind?
responses_tl: Walang anuman! Masaya akong nakatulong.
Anytime! Ingatan mo ang sarili mo.
Walang anuman. May iba ka pa bang gustong pag-usapan?

patterns_en: i have a test coming up and i'm scared
i'm scared i'll fail my exam
i'm nervous about my upcoming test
exams are making me so anxious
i can't stop worrying about my grades
patterns_tl: stress na stress ako sa exam
malapit na ang finals at kinakabahan ako
ang bigat ng pressure sa exam
responses_en: Exam stress is really common — try breaking your study sessions into smaller chunks with breaks in between. Would you like some study tips?
It's okay to feel anxious before exams. Try to get enough sleep and take breaks — your brain needs rest to retain information. Want to talk more about what's worrying you?
That sounds stressful. Remember that one exam doesn't define you. Have you talked to your teachers about how you're feeling?
responses_tl: Normal lang ang mararamdaman mong kabado bago mag-exam. Subukan mong hatiin ang pag-aaral mo sa maiikling bahagi na may pahinga sa gitna. Gusto mo ba ng tips sa pag-aaral?
Okay lang na mag-alala, pero siguraduhin mong sapat ang tulog mo. Kailangan ding magpahinga ang utak para matandaan ang mga aralin. Gusto mo bang pag-usapan kung ano talaga ang ikinakaba mo?
Naiintindihan ko na stressful iyan. Tandaan mo, hindi ka masusukat ng isang exam lang. Nakausap mo na ba ang teacher mo tungkol dito?

patterns_en: i don't know how to balance everything
there's too much to do and not enough time
i'm behind on all my requirements
i can't keep up with deadlines
patterns_tl: ang dami kong gawain hindi ko kaya
palagi akong nagpaplano pero hindi ko nagagawa
di ko na alam paano aabutan lahat
responses_en: Try making a simple daily schedule and prioritizing your top 3 tasks each day. Small steps really help!
Procrastination happens to everyone. Try the 'just 5 minutes' trick — start a task for just 5 minutes and often you'll keep going.
Breaking big tasks into smaller ones can make things feel less overwhelming. Want some tips on organizing your schedule?
responses_tl: Subukan mong gumawa ng simpleng schedule at unahin ang tatlong pinaka-importanteng gawain kada araw. Malaking tulong iyan!
Normal lang ang mag-procrastinate paminsan-minsan. Subukan mong gawin ang gawain nang 5 minuto lang muna — kadalasan, magpapatuloy ka na.
Kapag hinati mo ang malaking gawain sa maliliit na bahagi, mas magaan ang pakiramdam. Gusto mo ba ng tips sa pag-oorganisa ng schedule mo?

patterns_en: people are being mean to me at school
my classmates keep making fun of me
i'm scared to go to school because of bullies
patterns_tl: pinagtatawanan ako ng mga kaklase ko
may naninira sa akin sa school
takot akong pumasok dahil may bully
sinisiraan ako ng mga kaklase ko
responses_en: I'm really sorry you're going through that. Bullying is never okay, and you don't have to handle it alone. Please consider talking to your guidance counselor or a trusted teacher about this.
That sounds really hard. You deserve to feel safe at school. I'd strongly encourage you to report this to your counselor — would you like help reaching out to them?
responses_tl: Pasensya na talaga na dumaranas ka niyan. Hindi dapat pinapayagan ang bullying, at hindi mo kailangang harapin ito nang mag-isa. Pag-isipan mong kausapin ang guidance counselor o isang gurong pinagkakatiwalaan mo.
Mahirap talaga iyan. Dapat ligtas ang pakiramdam mo sa school. Hinihikayat kitang i-report ito sa counselor mo — gusto mo bang tulungan kitang makipag-usap sa kanila?

patterns_en: my parents are fighting a lot
i'm having problems with my parents
there's a lot of stress at home
my parents are getting a divorce
i don't get along with my family
patterns_tl: hindi ako naiintindihan ng pamilya ko
may problema ako sa magulang ko
hindi ako sang-ayon sa magulang ko
responses_en: Family struggles can be really tough to deal with. I'm here to listen. Have you considered talking to your guidance counselor about this too? They can offer more support.
That sounds difficult. You're not alone in this — your school counselor is a safe person to talk to if you'd like more support.
responses_tl: Talagang mahirap harapin ang mga problema sa pamilya. Nandito ako para makinig. Pag-isipan mo ring kausapin ang guidance counselor mo para sa dagdag na suporta.
Mahirap iyan. Hindi ka nag-iisa dito — ang counselor ng school mo ay ligtas na taong pwede mong kausapin kung gusto mo ng dagdag na tulong.

patterns_en: i had a fight with my friend
my best friend and i aren't talking anymore
i feel left out by my friends
patterns_tl: iniiwasan ako ng mga kaibigan ko
hindi na kami magkausap ng best friend ko
hindi ako sinasali ng barkada ko
responses_en: Friendship troubles can really hurt. Do you want to talk about what happened?
Feeling lonely at school is hard. Sometimes joining a club or activity can help you meet new people who share your interests.
responses_tl: Mahirap talaga ang problema sa friendship. Gusto mo bang ikwento kung ano ang nangyari?
Mahirap ang mapag-isa sa school. Minsan makakatulong ang pagsali sa isang club o activity para makakilala ka ng bagong kaibigan na may parehong interes.

patterns_en: i don't know what course to take in college
i need help planning my career
i don't know what i want to do after graduation
how do i choose the right college course
patterns_tl: hindi ko alam kung anong course kukunin
ano bang course ang bagay sa akin
anong strand ang dapat kong kunin
kailangan ko ng tulong sa pagpaplano ng career ko
di ko alam gagawin ko pagtapos
responses_en: That's a big decision! Our Career Guidance program can help you explore your interests and strengths. Would you like to talk to your counselor about a career assessment?
It's completely normal to feel unsure about your future. Think about what subjects you enjoy most, and consider booking an appointment with your counselor to explore your options.
responses_tl: Malaking desisyon iyan! Matutulungan ka ng Career Guidance program namin na alamin ang interes at lakas mo. Gusto mo bang kausapin ang counselor mo para sa career assessment?

Normal lang na hindi sigurado sa future. Isipin mo kung anong subjects ang pinaka-gusto mong pag-aralan, at pag-isipan mong mag-book ng appointment sa counselor mo para matulungan kang alamin ang mga options mo.

patterns_en: i feel like i'm not good at anything
i always feel like i disappoint everyone
responses_en: I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. You matter, and these feelings, while very real, don't define your worth. Please consider talking to your guidance counselor — they can offer real support.
That sounds really painful to carry. You're not alone, and it might really help to talk to your counselor or someone you trust about how you've been feeling.
responses_tl: Pasensya na talaga na ganito ang nararamdaman mo. Mahalaga ka, at ang mga nararamdaman mong ito, kahit totoo, ay hindi sumusukat sa halaga mo bilang tao. Pag-isipan mong kausapin ang guidance counselor mo — may tunay silang maibibigay na suporta.
Mabigat talagang dalhin iyan. Hindi ka nag-iisa, at makakatulong talaga kung kakausapin mo ang counselor mo o isang taong pinagkakatiwalaan mo tungkol dito.

patterns_en: i don't want to live anymore
i want to end my life
i don't want to be alive anymore
patterns_tl: gusto kong saktan ang sarili ko
papatayin ko na lang sarili ko
responses_en: I'm really concerned about what you just shared, and your safety matters most right now. Please reach out immediately to a trusted adult, your guidance counselor, or a parent/guardian. If you're in immediate danger, please contact emergency services right away. You don't have to go through this alone.
responses_tl: Lubos akong nag-aalala sa sinabi mo, at ang kaligtasan mo ang pinakamahalaga ngayon. Mangyaring makipag-usap agad sa isang taong may tiwala mo, sa guidance counselor mo, o sa magulang/guardian mo. Kung nasa agarang panganib ka, mangyaring tumawag agad sa emergency services. Hindi mo kailangang harapin ito nang mag-isa.

responses_en: I'm not totally sure I understand — could you tell me a bit more about what's going on?
I want to make sure I understand you correctly. Could you rephrase that?
I'm still learning! Could you say that in a different way, or would you like to talk to your guidance counselor directly about this?
responses_tl: Hindi ko lubos na naintindihan — pwede mo bang ipaliwanag pa nang kaunti?
Gusto kong masiguradong naiintindihan kita nang tama. Pwede mo bang sabihin ulit sa ibang paraan?
Marami pa akong kailangang matutunan! Pwede mo bang sabihin sa ibang paraan, o gusto mo na lang kausapin agad ang guidance counselor mo tungkol dito?
